# Create a run of show

Produce the cue sheet an event team can operate, not a promotional agenda.

<!-- playbooks:start (generated by tools/knowledge-map.mjs; edit the files, not this list) -->

## Establish the event contract

Define the event type, date and time zone, total duration, attendee outcome, qualified next action,
format, audience, cast, venue or platform, recording and consent boundary, and decision owner. Confirm
hard start/end constraints and who has authority to cut or hold a segment.

List dependencies and preflight owners for access, speakers, demo state, media, screen share, audio,
captions, recording, privacy, room or stream setup, moderation, and follow-up capture. Mark anything
unconfirmed rather than inventing readiness.

## Build the executable cue sheet

Create a minute-by-minute table with clock time, elapsed time, duration, segment, attendee action,
speaker or host, producer or technical owner, public content, private cue, required asset, transition,
and fallback. Include buffers deliberately; do not hide them inside segments.

Protect the attendee outcome when time slips. Define the cut order, time warnings, handoff language,
and recovery for demo failure, absent speaker, broken screen share, low attendance, moderation trouble,
recording failure, and overrun. A contingency must name its trigger, owner, replacement action, and
return path.

## Close the operational loop

Add a readiness gate and final go/no-go owner. Separate consent-aware attendee follow-up from internal
debrief. Assign the qualified follow-up owner, timing, source of truth, primary outcome signal, and
diagnostics; attendance alone is not success.

## Deliver

Return:

1. event contract, cast, contacts, and authority boundaries;
2. preflight checklist with owner, deadline, status, and no-go condition;
3. complete cue sheet with buffers and private cues;
4. contingency and recovery matrix;
5. follow-up and measurement handoff;
6. unresolved dependencies and final human approval boundary.

Do not schedule the event, invite or contact people, change a live platform, start recording, or send
follow-up without explicit approval for the exact action.

Before delivery, load the recovered method instead of paraphrasing it:

- [segment planner](agents/segment-planner-agent.md) for the timed segment list;
- [logistics director](agents/logistics-director-agent.md) for owners, cues, preflight, and
  contingencies;
- [critic](agents/critic-agent.md) for the five-dimension stress test;
- [anti-patterns](references/anti-patterns.md) and
  [format conventions](references/format-conventions.md) before ship;
- [worked example](references/examples/runofshow-walkthrough.md) when calibrating a launch webinar
  shape.
